title: Rams sign Kam Curl to 3-year deal; Darious Williams retires amid changes to secondary

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Rams sign Kam Curl to 3-year deal; Darious Williams retires amid changes to secondary
sources.description: Safety Kam Curl, one of the top performers in the Rams' secondary, agrees to a three-year deal with the team that includes about $24 million in guarantees.
